title: Printed (4), first half: points y_i → x and indices q_i → ∞ with y_i ∈ W ∖ Bad_{q_i}
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let W ⊆ ℝ^N = Euclidean N be open, let Bad_ℓ ⊆ ℝ^N (ℓ ∈ ℕ) be arbitrary sets, and let x ∈ W satisfy x ∉ interior(⋂_{ℓ≥i} Bad_ℓ) for every i ∈ ℕ. Then there are q : ℕ → ℕ and y : ℕ → ℝ^N with q_i → ∞ and y_i → x as i → ∞, such that y_i ∈ W and y_i ∉ Bad_{q_i} for every i.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (W : Set (Euclidean N)) (Bad : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N), IsOpen W → x ∈ W → (∀ i : ℕ, x ∉ interior (⋂ ℓ : ℕ, ⋂ (_ : i ≤ ℓ), Bad ℓ)) → ∃ (q : ℕ → ℕ) (y : ℕ → Euclidean N), Tendsto q atTop atTop ∧ Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 x) ∧ ∀ i, y i ∈ W ∧ y i ∉ Bad (q i)
